test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In September 2022 the book ‘Ambedkar and Modi: Reformer’s Ideas Performer’s Implementation’ has been written by which of the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Nath Kovind**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ram Nath Kovind** is the author of the book 'Ambedkar and Modi: Reformer's Ideas Performer's Implementation'.
 
• The book highlights the convergence between Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's vision and Prime Minister Narendra Modi's implementation of reforms.
 
• It focuses on various aspects of social and economic reforms in India, drawing parallels between the two leaders' contributions.
 
• The book was released in September 2022 and has been a significant addition to literature on modern Indian reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Nath Kovind** served as the 14th President of India from 25th July 2017 to 25th July 2022.
 
• Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, known as the father of the Indian Constitution, was a social reformer, jurist, and politician who fought against social discrimination towards the untouchables (Dalits).
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been known for implementing various socio-economic reforms aimed at inclusive development and social justice.
